title: [DocDB] TEST_docdb_log_write_batches no longer supported after DirectWrites
body:
Jira Link: [DB-499](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-499)
### Description

TEST_docdb_log_write_batches used to be useeful to see when kvs are added to Intent/Regular DB.

Turning this on now results in a crash.
